Subject: Post-call recap + next steps: Onramp & decision journey

Thanks for the time today — quick recap and proposed next steps from our side.

Attendees: Ava, Tom (NewLogix); Monica (Redwood); Priyom (SE, on call)

Goal: Run a 6-week POC showing extraction + summarization on a sample of 6.5k patient notes; success criteria defined as:
- >85% precision on redaction checks for PHI
- Average generation latency < 300ms p50 for 512-token outputs
- Cost target: <= $0.006 / 1k tokens after batching + cache

Decision timeline (as discussed): POC approval by mid-Jan, procurement/contracting shortly after.

Open risk / asks you mentioned:
- Security evidence required (SOC2, data residency, audit logs)
- Legal review for data processing agreement + SLAs
- Procurement process & PO cadence (who signs & estimated procurement lead time)

Immediate asks from us:
1) Please confirm the economic buyer (name + best email).
2) Legal / vendor risk contact for security artifacts.
3) Procurement contact or expected PO timeline.

Next steps I propose:
- We will draft a short mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and ownership; Priyom will own the MAP draft.
- Rishi will outline a pricing proposal tied to the POC milestones.
- Proposed internal alignment call: Tue 11/16 (30m) to review MAP + pricing — is that ok?

I attached a small intake workbook (NLX_map_inputs.xlsx) with sections for decision owners, milestone dates, and required evidence — if you can populate the buyer/procurement fields it will speed the MAP creation.

Thanks again — quick replies welcome.

--
